Key.title: Access Key
Key.description: A single-device license access key with 7-day expiration

days.description: The custom lease duration of the key in days (max 7 days)

deviceId.description: Unique client hardware or browser device fingerprint

activatedAt.description: Unix timestamp in ms when the key was activated on the device

expiresAt.description: Unix timestamp in ms representing the absolute session limit

keys/{keyId}.description: Collection of activated or pre-commissioned license verification keys
